fact: Xalam Analytics estimates about 4 live commercial data centre facilities in Rwanda in 2025, with about 1MW live IT load and about 70% occupancy by third-party customers; facilities are small (20-80 racks) and mostly hybrid, leasing excess capacity to external customers; none are named.

Xalam Analytics estimates about 4 live commercial data centre facilities in Rwanda in 2024, with about 1MW live IT load and about 60% occupancy by third-party customers; facilities are mostly hybrid, leasing excess capacity to external customers, and none are named.

TransAfrica Communications (TrAC), a Rwanda-based ISP, is stated to offer data centre collocation services to customers (no facility named, no tier given); the release is undated, so as_of is its July 2025 month.

The ministry's ICT Sector Strategic Plan lists, among the initiatives that improved local hosting, the introduction of the TransAfrica Communications (TrAC) data center in Rwanda; the document gives no opening date, so as_of is its published date 2025-01-01.
Data centres dataset: Liquid Intelligent Technologies Rwanda (Liquid Intelligent Technologies Rwanda), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2025-03-24).
